expertiseSources.summary: Records the immutable upstream commit, operational lessons, portability changes, overlap boundaries, and security review for the migrated worktree orchestration workflow.
Distinguishes historical identities from runtime worker capabilities and defines privacy-preserving, bounded trace analysis.

exception.rationale: The workflow reduces checkout collisions, overlapping writes, and unvalidated integration. It propagates verified skill-loading routes and messaging capabilities, batches known recipients within host limits, and preserves unavailable workers' ownership. Compact handoffs also bind runtime/provider, requested and observed model or unknown, usable handle, and checkout identity; read-only worker persistence stays coordinator-owned. This requests a safety exception; human approval and matched efficiency gains are not claimed.
